steps.label: test
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && mkdir -p mus_test && cd mus_test && : > status.txt && for u in https://freepd.com/ https://freepd.com/upbeat.php https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/music.html https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/mp3-royaltyfree/Carefree.mp3 https://archive.org/ https://pixabay.com/music/ https://cdn.pixabay.com/ https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/ https://www.bensound.com/ https://mixkit.co/free-stock-music/ https://www.chosic.com/free-music/all/ https://ccmixter.org/ https://opengameart.org/ https://upload.wikimedia.org/; do printf "%s " "$u" >> status.txt; curl -s -L -o /dev/null -m 12 -A "Mozilla/5.0" -w "%{http_code}\n" "$u" >> status.txt || echo fail >> status.txt; done; curl -s -L -m 20 -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o freepd.html https://freepd.com/ ; curl -s -L -m 20 -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o freepd_up.html https://freepd.com/upbeat.php; curl -s -L -m 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o incomp.html "https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/music.html"; ls -l >> status.txt; true
